Microsoft Edge WebView2 — notice

MAD Designer (Windows) hosts its report preview in the Microsoft Edge WebView2
control. The control is supplied by the Microsoft.Web.WebView2 NuGet package
(pinned in Windows/App/Mad.Designer.Windows/Mad.Designer.Windows.csproj).

The control requires the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. The Evergreen runtime
is a Microsoft redistributable that ships with Windows 11 and is installed
alongside Microsoft Edge on Windows 10; this application neither modifies nor
redistributes the runtime. It is not open-source software, and no open-source
licence text applies to it.

Use of the WebView2 control and the WebView2 Runtime is governed by Microsoft's
software licence terms. See:

	https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/
	https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/

Microsoft and Microsoft Edge are trademarks of Microsoft Corporation.
